summary: Targeted frontend verification of the iteration_6 MEDIUM hydration bug (span inside <option>). Verified /mortgage-calculator: currency select renders all 13 options as plain text (no element children in option innerHTML), no console errors/warnings containing 'cannot be a child of <option>' or hydration. Calculation default gives Monthly Payment 2,514.28; switching to INR (₹2,514.28) and EUR (2.514,28 €) changes only the symbol/locale formatting, numeric value unchanged, input prefixes updated. Spot-checked home-loan-emi-calculator, sip-calculator, mortgage-decision-calculator — 13 clean options each, zero console errors.
critical_code_review_comments: CalculatorRenderer.jsx line 98 now renders a single template-literal string per <option>, which is the correct fix for the DOM-nesting/hydration warning.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Hydration <option> warning is resolved; currency switching verified on 4 money calculators. No open frontend issues.
rca_of_the_issue: Preview instrumentation wrapped multiple JSX text expressions inside <option> in spans, producing invalid HTML nesting. Replaced with one template-literal string child; verified option innerHTML contains no '<'.
